description: Persistent registry of independently searchable QA/test vacancy sources. Maintained by the mandatory Source Scout each complete search cycle.

sources.name: LinkedIn Jobs
sources.query_or_url_pattern: site:linkedin.com/jobs/view QA Test Berlin Leipzig Dresden Germany Remote

sources.name: Arbeitsagentur Jobsuche
sources.query_or_url_pattern: Softwaretester QA Testautomatisierung Berlin Leipzig Dresden Deutschland

sources.name: StepStone
sources.query_or_url_pattern: https://www.stepstone.de/jobs?where=<encoded location>&what=<encoded role query>; browser/Camofox sequential listing and direct detail verification

sources.name: XING Jobs
sources.query_or_url_pattern: QA Software Test Engineer Germany last month

sources.name: Remotive
sources.query_or_url_pattern: https://remotive.com/api/remote-jobs?search=QA (filter category=Quality Assurance; location=Germany; direct card URL https://remotive.com/remote/jobs/qa/<slug>-<id>)

sources.name: Arbeitnow Job Board API
sources.query_or_url_pattern: https://www.arbeitnow.com/api/job-board-api (filter JSON records by title/description/location for QA, Software Test, Test Automation, Germany, Berlin, Leipzig, Dresden, remote)

sources.name: GermanTechJobs
sources.query_or_url_pattern: https://germantechjobs.de/rss (fetch current feed; filter title+description for Softwaretester, Software Tester, QA Engineer, Quality Assurance, Test Engineer, Testautomatisierung, Qualitätssicherung; direct card pattern https://germantechjobs.de/jobs/<slug>)

sources.name: EuroTechJobs Test Analyst / Germany
sources.query_or_url_pattern: https://www.eurotechjobs.com/jobs/test_analyst and https://www.eurotechjobs.com/jobs/germany; intersect/filter cards for Germany, Berlin, Leipzig, Dresden, or Germany-wide remote; direct cards /job_display/<id>/<slug>

sources.name: Adzuna Deutschland
sources.query_or_url_pattern: https://www.adzuna.de/search?q=<urlencoded German QA query>&loc=<location-id>; city discovery /berlin/<query>, /leipzig/<query>, /dresden/<query>; pagination &p=<page>

retired_sources.name: Direct company ATS and career sites
retired_sources.query_or_url_pattern: company career site QA Test Engineer Germany
retired_sources.retired_reason: Heterogeneous source class without a concrete independently searchable host/API; direct company ATS must be discovered and registered as concrete hosts by Source Scout.

scout_history.notes: Broad German discovery plus direct live checks. GermanTechJobs public RSS exposed 992 analyzable direct job cards, including Senior QA Engineer and Test Engineer/Test Automation; added. Landing.jobs API was 404, Jobicy tag query 400, Honeypot legacy API 410, We Work Remotely and Berlin Startup Jobs remained 403, and GermanTechJobs web-search shell was correctly superseded by its live RSS. No source retired; vacancy master untouched.

Discovery extended beyond the registry. EuroTechJobs test-analyst listing exposed 22 live direct cards, including a live Senior Software Tester card in Düsseldorf, Germany; added as a new searchable European tech source. GameDevJobs exposed direct game-QA cards but no current Germany/Berlin/Leipzig/Dresden card; retained as a rejected-for-current-scope candidate. RemoteOK exposed a QA listing/filter but its current 100-record API snapshot had no Germany QA/test record. gamedevmap is an employer directory, not a vacancy listing. jobs.ch search was Switzerland-focused and exposed no German QA card. No registry source retired; public vacancy list untouched.

Broad live discovery verified Adzuna Deutschland with browser and web extraction: analyzable /land/ad cards included QM Prüfer (Everllence SE, Berlin) and HOME-OFFICE coverage; curl independently returned 403. Added Adzuna as a new parent. Joblift redirects to Adzuna and was treated as duplicate. Landing.Jobs Germany QA had 0 results; DevITJobs is UK-only; stellenwerk had live direct cards but its current QA query was empty. Existing history retained; no vacancy/public-list modification.

Exactly one Source Scout completed for this cycle. Registry retained unchanged because no new non-duplicate source met live direct-card evidence and current German QA/test scope. No sources retired; no downstream stages started.
